Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Katy, Texas, when my car was struck on the driver's side
by a vehicle coming down the aisle. I had checked my mirrors and saw no one before I began to reverse, so the
impact caught me completely by surprise. I stopped right away, got out to exchange information, and stayed at the
scene until the other driver and I had spoken. Since then I have described what happened the same way every time I
have talked about it, whether with the adjuster, the body shop, or my doctor's office. Afterward my neck and lower
back were stiff and sore, and I have been going to physical therapy for strain in both areas. I am the named driver on
this policy and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
